author: Prakhar Singh
dataDisclosure: Synthetic scenario replay. This export is not evidence of a PayPal sandbox API call.
evidenceHashScope: Deterministic replay report before evidenceHash and AI output were appended. Export metadata and classifier output are outside this hash.

scenario.title: The refund that beat its payment
scenario.description: A refund arrives first; a stale sent event arrives last and regresses a naive worker.

timeline.reason: Observed sent event; ledger-derived status takes priority

findings.title: Refund dependency arrived late
findings.detail: A refund arrived before the payment it references. The protected reducer defers it rather than losing it.
findings.action: Resolve refund references after collecting trusted payments; quarantine unresolved dependencies.

findings.title: Delivery order differs from event order
findings.detail: A later arrival carries an older event timestamp. A last-event-wins worker can regress invoice state.
findings.action: Derive state from the transaction ledger; avoid assigning status directly from delivery order.

findings.title: Refund cannot be posted
findings.action: Fetch the missing payment or inspect the entire refund group; no inferred money is posted.

findings.title: Snapshot contains money absent from deliveries
findings.detail: Trusted observed payments total 0.00, while the synthetic snapshot reports 120.00 USD. The missing amount is not fabricated.
findings.action: Re-fetch the sandbox invoice and inspect webhook delivery history before changing the ledger.

replay.evidenceHashScope: SHA-256 of the entire deterministic replay report before evidenceHash and AI output are added; includes normalized input deliveries and transformations.
limitations: Normalized authored fixtures, not actual PayPal webhook payloads or verified signatures.
Replay is in-memory; durable ingestion, concurrency, and the full invoice lifecycle are outside this prototype.
Snapshot comparison can detect disagreement; it cannot prove which system is wrong.

ai.label: Missing delivery or state gap
ai.explanation: The trained local classifier ranks “Missing delivery or state gap” first. Supporting deterministic replay findings: Refund dependency arrived late; Refund cannot be posted; Snapshot contains money absent from deliveries. This is classifier inference from synthetic training, not proof of causality.
limitations: Trained and evaluated only on synthetic incidents; accuracy on real PayPal sandbox or production incidents has not been established.
Softmax scores are relative model scores, not calibrated probabilities of correctness.
Classifier inference cannot prove causality or verify payment authenticity.
The model summarizes aggregate metrics and can miss event sequence details; inspect the cited replay evidence.
Multiple incident signals are active. A single top class cannot describe every cause.
